ID.notes: All 986 House reporting-unit returns reconcile to complete county summaries and both district candidate APIs. 448 units map by unique complete county precinct-name sets and explicit congressional district to the official 2026 Idaho SOS reference. Only case, punctuation and numeric padding are normalized; no token reordering, aliases, ID decoding or vote allocation. Counties with inconsistent scope or any reference overlap above the audited tolerance are withheld. Separately reported absentee/early units remain unmapped; no pooled votes are allocated. Candidate votes are not turnout. Separate unofficial ballots/registration and all provisional fractions and withholding flags remain in the full download. These are source reporting units joined to reference precincts, not proof of complete residential all-ballot returns or demographic participation. Every original result workbook/PDF/API, every native and geographic GIS feature, unmatched return and county/geometry audit is retained.
ID.next_action: Obtain official county reporting-unit crosswalks, resolve reference overlap slivers and separately reported pooled-ballot scope. Resolve Twin Falls registration and other source ballot disagreements before enabling withheld rates. No ID-only matching or vote allocation.

metric: Candidate margins are not participation; source-defined provisional fractions remain separate.
